[b]Reichsadler Collaborative Combat Aircraft Demonstration-Büro für die Entwicklung Militärischer Technologien[/b]

[i]The Reichsadler or Imperial Eagle Collaborative Combat Aircraft or CCA project which began in 2005 and took its first flight in 2020 has proven its worthiness in combat exercises over the Westlicher Ozean. RCCA was established as a part of the Next Generation Weapons Initiative developed by the Büro für die Entwicklung Militärischer Technologien in collaboration with Luftwerke AG and Volkstechnologie. The Reichswehr believes that the CCA will aid the Luftstreitkräfte gain air superiority in saturated airspace and build on its current F-15 before-visual-range capabilities. The RCCA will be able to provide greater surveillance over a battlefield, improve targeting capabilities, provide force multiplication, and provide electronic warfare capabilities. In the demonstration on Friday, the RCCA reached speeds of up to Mach 1.5 and Mach 2.0 with ease. The CCA can be equipped with an arsenal of AAMs, AGM-65 Mavericks, JDAMs, PGMs and electronic warfare equipment. On the naval front, CCAs working with the Kaiserliche Marine have been outfitted with quickstrike anti-surface craft missiles. 

Fridays military test brought theory into reality. A group of RCCAs worked with an F-15 to strike a location in the Westlicher Ozean with various PGMs. Volkstechnologie defense software was able to integrate well with pre-existing F-15 systems and the mission was carried out successfully. In a speech following the successful military demonstration, the Hochkaiser stated that the test was emblematic of the Reichswehrs transformation into an effective and efficient modern fighting force.[/i]

The legends say taht when Chilla  complete.her 100.000th Cycle, she will turn red as blood, the Sapelléchilla(Supreme, absolute blood moon), the rains of Shéuco will rain blood, and the skies will turn dark, announcing the end of the Third Era, and the end of humanity , the red light of Chilla will take all over Camác (Erene), she will go down Erene and begin to unleash her powerful attacks against  Chatay, and a fight between two will begin, Sùpay will seize this opportunity and move to the deep seas and free Samantemán, and together they shall destroy Cochanamo and Muyvery, Samantemán will retake his place as good of seas once again.
The corn and crops will burn and rotten, the Ókallay will seize this to feed more.
Soon after being freed, Samantemán made the Mûybîkin leave it position in Wichansao and attack Muyvery, the goddess of sea creatures will have  body split in two, Cochanamo, in a act of fury  , will make the seas wrath atack Samantemán, Aypácheks and Kóyllûrchás will emerge to avenge their mother(Muyvery), and  Cochanamo will atack Samantemán with powerful waves and waters to avenge his beloved, however, when a devastating atack of Samantemán make Cochanamo fall into the seas, the Chûspìs will eat his flesh, Cochanamo will keep existing with his essence being imbued in the waters.
Cíkires will howl, Ñans will  abandon their nests, Chîs will attack humanity and all of Sùpay servants, Muychárós will be protected by Apû-Sáman, and will remain unharmed, Yácha and Kûnsù will remain at side of Sùpay, but no longer as his eyes, but to help him find any living human to hunt, and humans will feel the terror , only those powerful of heart, and faith will survive .
Atúkís will make webs to protect themselves against the floods, and prayers seeking protection from Apû-Sáman will happen, Wápìwan, neutral shall be overwhelmed as well as Táncuy will, many deads will have, Amárus will emerge and fight alongside Samantemán.
[b]The End of a Age[/b].
At the turning point , Chaska will came from the mountains, alongside his wife Wáchây (goddess of night , intelligence, protection , mind and wisdom), Apû-Sáman will move from his place in the mountains to fight alongside Chaska, Llápà (god of speed and mesengers) will fight alongside his brother Chaska and as well as Sansácun and her son, god of volcanoes Wâyná, and also Moyco.
The first jump of Chaska crush one of the Amaru's skull it will, then the gods will face each other, Llápà, 
Sansácun Wâyná , and Apû-Sáman will fight Samantemán and Sùpay, while Moyco would face his sister Shéuco, but the most important battle will be Chilla against Chaska, Wáchây and Chatay.
Weakened, and alone Chatay can never beat Sapelléchilla,  his armour will rust and his chest pierced several times by the brutal beams of his sister, Chaska will use his claws against his mother(You can think she uses "projections" of the moon as weapon), Wáchây will try to use her shield to protect her allies and trying to enter in Chilla's mind.
When Chilla launch all her wrath against Chaska, in a single flare of red light, Chaska will be hit, but, his [b]War Wrath [/b] was just launched, even his chest being opened by a hole, he took his Chataychámpi, and then smashed it against the  body of Sapelléchilla, who will fall against the ground then , try to protect herself, and that will be when, in a familiar situation, Chatay and Chaska will do a simultaneous atack, imbued by the solar energy of a Chatay's flare, one of the Chillawáràk's stones  of Chaska will hit her into her face, and then breaking the Sapelléchilla, allowing Wáchây enter in her mind, then making Chilla regret for her actions, this is when she wil leave her mantle of silver, bloody in the ground, and will left as a silver coloured owl.
Shéuco will lose her corruption, and then launch a powerful whirwind against Samantemán, who will fall into the ground, seeing oportuñity , Apû-Sáman will throw his colossal mountains over Samantemán, imprisoning him there, forever in eternal sufering, surrounded, Sùpay will be attacked by several fast hits of Llápà, buf Sùpay will counter, hitting his leg with a darkness claw, but soon, he will launch a final vortex to end up with everything, in a desperate try, [i]if i can not have anything, none of you will ever have[/i].
But, something unexpected will happen, for the first time , and only , Táncuy will leave his post, as ferryman, as the chaos caused by bloody moon overwhelmed the entire system of Wápítî, and therefore, he would end the last reason of this, personally, Táncuy will make use of his staff, and with a single attack, will launch a bomb of water , of the Pâkatwan(the staff generated water ) and Sùpay will fall into his own vortex.
[b]The dawning of the 4th Age[/b].
Chaska will become new god of gods, alongside Wáchây his wife, goddess of Moon, night , wisdom, intelligence, mind and protection, Chatay will keep his role, and the new gods will eventually substitue the others , Chatay will keep as Ardagan, and the Muychárós, and humans remanescents are now warrior people , honoured and brave man, ruling now Camác, and this, is how the 3rd era will end, and the 4th will begin.
[b]notes[/b]:
Approximately, the 100.000 cycle would be the year  5438 AC for Gregorian calendar, and the 
Year in  Chimor calendar 7938.
